name: Lanxin Robotics
summary:
Lanxin Robotics develops industrial mobile robots built around 3D visual perception. Its technology links environmental sensing with navigation and practical factory operations, using deployed mobile platforms to connect AI capabilities with physical work. The company emphasizes industrial integration and customer value rather than navigation demonstrations in isolation.

Its public history describes progression from commercial mobile-robot deployments to supply relationships with manufacturers including Huawei and BYD. The business combines robot platforms, perception technology and application delivery, supporting the movement and handling needs of production environments. Its development work contributes to the broader embodied-intelligence ecosystem through industrial mobility and visual understanding.
